title: Extended LASMP: Language Aided Subset Sampling Based Motion Planner for Drone Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34054v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes a command-aligned sampling distribution that incorporates navigation commands directly into the exploration process to improve the efficiency of sampling-based motion planning for quadcopters in three-dimensional environments. Inspired by the Language-Aided Subset Sampling Motion Planner, this paper extends command-aware subset sampling to aerial systems. Subset sampling is generalized to command-aligned regions, enabling structured 3D exploration while preserving probabilistic completeness. Natural language instructions are grounded into yaw-conditioned and altitude-aware geometric constraints using a prompt-based large language model for entity extraction and instruction validation. Extensive simulations in complex environments demonstrate that the proposed method generates collision-free, consistent trajectories while significantly reducing sampling effort compared to uniform RRT-based planners.

translated_title: 扩展LASMP：基于语言辅助子集采样的无人机导航运动规划器
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种命令对齐的采样分布，将导航命令直接融入探索过程，以提高四旋翼飞行器在三维环境中基于采样的运动规划效率。受语言辅助子集采样运动规划器的启发，本文将命令感知的子集采样扩展到航空系统中。子集采样被推广到命令对齐的区域，在保持概率完备性的同时实现结构化的三维探索。利用基于提示的大语言模型进行实体提取和指令验证，将自然语言指令落地为偏航条件约束和高度感知的几何约束。在复杂环境中的大量仿真表明，与基于均匀采样的RRT规划器相比，所提出的方法能够生成无碰撞且一致的轨迹，同时显著减少采样工作量。
tldr: 本文提出扩展LASMP方法，利用大语言模型将自然语言导航命令转化为偏航条件和高度感知的命令对齐采样区域，使无人机在保持概率完备性的同时显著降低采样开销并生成无碰撞的轨迹。
en_tdlr: This paper extends LASMP to drone navigation by leveraging an LLM to ground natural language commands into yaw-conditioned and altitude-aware command-aligned sampling regions, enabling probabilistically complete, collision-free trajectories with significantly reduced sampling effort.
